claim: Design-Bench defines offline MBO as posing substantially different algorithmic challenges from online BO because no further queries to the true objective are allowed after the fixed dataset is collected.
stance_target: Establishing the offline/online distinction load-bearing for the Shahriari scope-guard claim
quoted_support: This setting--called offline MBO--poses substantial and different algorithmic challenges than more commonly studied online techniques.

claim: Design-Bench provides a unified evaluation protocol and reference implementations across realistic tasks in biology, materials science, and robotics, establishing itself as the field's standard benchmark.
stance_target: Establishing Design-Bench's role as the canonical evaluation surface later cited by Chemingui, RaM, and SOO-Bench
quoted_support: To address this, we present Design-Bench, a benchmark for offline MBO with a unified evaluation protocol and reference implementations of recent methods. Our benchmark includes a suite of diverse and realistic tasks derived from real-world optimization problems in biology, materials science, and robotics.
